channels.chip-accounting-pool: the untraced pool (phys-chips-unaccounted), the stock chip accounting cannot see
channels.chip-accounting-smuggled: compute smuggled into one country through 2025 (org-smuggled-cum)
channels.commercial-anonymity: a load below phys-commercial-load sits among millions of commercial customers; above it a load is not anonymous, which is not the same as found
channels.container: a cluster at or below phys-container-cluster fits in a 12-metre container with no noticeable external cooling
channels.grid-study: a US utility's system impact study (phys-utility-study); blind to power generated behind the meter
channels.not-modelled: channels that see the sites of a distributed run together: traffic between sites, purchases of chips and power, construction, insiders. Each is an aggregate signature E8 does not test, so E8 cannot show that only chip accounting sees the aggregate
channels.satellite: discovery of a site from imagery; central limit phys-sat-reliable
channels.thermal-infrared: did not see a cluster of at least phys-jing-cluster-power, so the true limit is higher: margins are lower bounds and crossing years are the latest

constants.base_year_from: date of phys-colossus1-facility-power, when the power per chip was measured
constants.last_year_from: base year plus phys-years-to-cmos-fast, rounded up
constants.t_sweep_note: one month, 2, 3, 6 and 12 months are sweep points; 4.5 and 24 are the ledger's run lengths

conventions.bound: FP8 peak (phys-h100-fp8), full utilisation, and phys-epoch-dc-it-per-h100e: the lowest footprint any party training at FP8 or above could reach
conventions.central: phys-util-ref, phys-facility-power-per-h100, phys-sat-reliable, phys-eff-growth-supercomputer, phys-algo-growth, no denial
conventions.crossing: first calendar year at or below the limit; the base year if already below; null if not by last_year
conventions.definitional: distributed_per_site_margins and e8-distributed-* are above 1 by the definition of the per-site floor; they are not evidence
conventions.hidden_in_known_site_h100e: site size within which a floor-sized run (central) hides: satellite sizing within phys-sat-it-accuracy at phys-sat-it-confidence, metering within each beta
conventions.margin: detection limit over the floor the channel sees; above 1 the run is below what the channel can see
conventions.pool_growth: the pool and the smuggled stock are held at their ledger values in every year; E22 supplies growth
conventions.precision: central figures and the Monte Carlo count at BF16 (phys-h100-bf16); at FP8 divide every chip, energy and power floor by phys-fp8-over-bf16 and multiply every chip-accounting margin by it
conventions.run_length: the adversary chooses T; chip floors scale as 1/T, and chip_time_floor gives the T-free form
conventions.seen_share: share of draws with margin at or below 1
conventions.untraced_as_a100: if every untraced chip were A100-class the pool would be 0.3153 of its H100e value

1e25.note: nodes times phys-rahman-bandwidth; the ledger has no detection limit for traffic between sites, so no margin

1e26.note: nodes times phys-rahman-bandwidth; the ledger has no detection limit for traffic between sites, so no margin

distributions.algorithmic_rate: log-uniform between comp-gundlach-small-annual-max and phys-algo-miri, the range P4 names; no sourced distribution. Used only for a fixed capability
distributions.denial_multiplier: uniform between 1 (smuggled leading-edge chips) and org-denial-power-multiplier (domestic chips at a denied party's measured compute per unit of power); no sourced distribution. Applied only to a denied party
distributions.efficiency_growth: two-piece log-normal matched to phys-eff-growth-supercomputer and its published 90% interval (-low, -high)
distributions.power_per_h100e_w: log-uniform between phys-epoch-dc-it-per-h100e and phys-facility-power-per-h100, the ledger's spread; no sourced distribution. The low end is IT power without cooling, so it understates facility power
distributions.precision: not drawn: the precision is the adversary's choice, so it is a stated input. The estimate counts at BF16 (phys-h100-bf16); the bound at FP8 (phys-h100-fp8). An FP8 run's floors are the BF16 ones divided by phys-fp8-over-bf16, power per chip unchanged
distributions.satellite_limit_mw: log-uniform between phys-sat-miss-max (largest site missed) and phys-sat-reliable (every larger site found); no sourced distribution
distributions.smuggled_stock_h100e: two-piece log-normal matched to org-smuggled-cum and its published 90% interval (-low, -high)
distributions.untraced_pool: log-uniform within a factor of sqrt(10) of phys-chips-unaccounted: our reading of 'order of magnitude', not a sourced range. Counted one chip per H100e, as the ledger does
distributions.utilisation: uniform between phys-intellect1-mfu-low and phys-pope-mfu-prefill, the measured range; no sourced distribution. The top end is an inference prefill figure, not training, so the Monte Carlo is an estimate; the bound uses full utilisation instead

e8-cap-years-1e24-bound.label: years one cluster at MIRI's unmonitored cap needs for 1e24 FLOP at the bound (FP8, full utilisation); below a pause's 24-month run length means the cap alone does not stop such a run

e8-chip-years-1e24-bound.label: chip-time floor of a 1e24 FLOP run as a bound (FP8, full utilisation)

e8-chip-years-1e26-bound.label: chip-time floor of a 1e26 FLOP run as a bound (FP8, full utilisation): the chip floor at any run length T is this divided by T, so it holds whatever run length the adversary picks

e8-concentrated-1e25-now-seen.label: share of draws in which a 1e25 FLOP run on one site over today's longest sensible run draws at least the satellite limit (drawn between the largest miss and the reliable line)

e8-concentrated-1e25-now-seen-denied.label: the same share for a denied party's site

e8-concentrated-1e26-pause-seen.label: share of draws in which a 1e26 FLOP run on one site over a pause's run length draws at least the satellite limit

e8-concentrated-1e26-pause-seen-denied.label: the same share for a denied party's site

e8-cross-container-1e26-pause-capability.label: first year the chip floor of the capability 1e26 FLOP buys in the base year, at a pause's run length, fits one container, algorithms at the measured rate (counted from 2024, the year the power per chip was measured; 2024 means already below)

e8-cross-grid-1e26-now.label: first year a 1e26 FLOP run on one site over today's run length draws less than a utility's system impact study threshold, fixed compute, central inputs (counted from 2024, the year the power per chip was measured; 2024 means already below)

e8-cross-sat-1e26-now.label: first year a 1e26 FLOP run on one site over today's run length draws less than the satellite reliable line, fixed compute, central inputs (counted from 2024, the year the power per chip was measured; 2024 means already below)

e8-cross-sat-1e26-now-denied.label: the same first year for a denied party at the full denial multiplier, central inputs

e8-cross-sat-1e26-now-p05.label: the same first year, 5th percentile of the Monte Carlo (efficiency trend, utilisation, power per H100e, satellite limit)

e8-cross-sat-1e26-now-p95.label: the same first year, 95th percentile of the Monte Carlo (efficiency trend, utilisation, power per H100e, satellite limit)

e8-cross-sat-1e27-pause.label: first year a 1e27 FLOP run on one site over a pause's run length draws less than the satellite reliable line, fixed compute, central inputs (counted from 2024, the year the power per chip was measured; 2024 means already below)

e8-cross-sat-1e27-pause-capability.label: the same first year for the capability 1e27 FLOP buys in the base year, with algorithms at the measured rate

e8-denial-delay-years.label: years by which the full denial multiplier delays a power channel's crossing for a fixed compute, at the measured efficiency trend

e8-distributed-1e25-margin-min.label: DEFINITIONAL, not evidence: smallest margin over every facility channel and every draw for a distributed 1e25 FLOP run on one-node sites, a denied party's power included (the smallest is commercial-anonymity). Above 1 by the definition of the per-site floor, so it cannot refute or support C8(b)
e8-distributed-1e25-margin-min.note: the per-site floor is one node whatever C is, so no input E8 varies could bring this below 1; do not cite as support

e8-distributed-sat-margin.label: DEFINITIONAL, not evidence: satellite's reliable line over one node's facility power, central inputs (a ratio of two inputs, the same for every run)
e8-distributed-sat-margin.note: do not cite as support for C8(b)

e8-floor-1e24-pause-bound.label: aggregate chip floor for 1e24 FLOP over a pause's longest sensible run as a bound: FP8 at full utilisation

e8-floor-1e26-pause-bound.label: the same floor as a bound: FP8, the lowest precision the sources show training at scale, at full utilisation. No party training at FP8 or above needs fewer H100e for this run in this time

e8-floor-1e26-pause-p50.label: aggregate chip floor for 1e26 FLOP over a pause's longest sensible run, median over utilisation drawn uniform across the measured range (no sourced distribution; its top is an inference figure). An estimate at the BF16 reference precision: an FP8 run halves it

e8-floor-check.label: E8's chip floor for 1e26 FLOP over today's longest sensible run, over the ledger's (1 means E8 reproduces it)

e8-pool-over-floor-1e26-pause-p50.label: the untraced pool over the chip floor of a 1e26 FLOP run at a pause's run length, median of the Monte Carlo (floor at the BF16 reference precision; an FP8 run doubles the ratio). The pool is an assumed order of magnitude and its spread is our reading; the smuggled stock has a published interval

e8-pool-shrink-1e24-pause.label: factor by which the untraced pool exceeds the bound chip floor (FP8, full utilisation) of a 1e24 FLOP run at a pause's run length: how far it must shrink for chip accounting to resolve that run
e8-pool-shrink-1e24-pause.note: the pool is an assumed order of magnitude (phys-chips-unaccounted); a longer run raises the factor in proportion

e8-pool-shrink-1e26-pause.label: the same factor for a 1e26 FLOP run

e8-power-1e26-now-p50.label: average facility power of a 1e26 FLOP run over today's longest sensible run, median of the Monte Carlo over utilisation and power per H100e (an estimate at the BF16 reference precision; an FP8 run halves it)

e8-power-1e26-pause-denied-p95.label: average facility power of a 1e26 FLOP run over a pause's run length for a denied party, 95th percentile (denial multiplier drawn uniform from 1 to the ledger's value)

e8-power-1e26-pause-p50.label: average facility power of a 1e26 FLOP run over a pause's longest sensible run, median of the Monte Carlo over utilisation and power per H100e (an estimate at the BF16 reference precision; an FP8 run halves it)

e8-sat-max-c-now.label: largest run one site below the satellite reliable line can finish within today's longest sensible run, central inputs, base year

e8-sat-max-c-pause.label: largest run one site below the satellite reliable line can finish within a pause's longest sensible run, central inputs, base year

e8-sat-max-c-pause-bound.label: the same at a pause's run length as a bound: the lowest power per H100e in the ledger, FP8, full utilisation

e8-sat-max-c-pause-denied.label: the same at a pause's run length for a denied party at the full denial multiplier, central inputs

e8-sat-min-t-1e26.label: shortest run length at which a 1e26 FLOP run on one site draws less than the satellite reliable line, base year, central inputs at BF16: any longer run the adversary picks is below it

e8-sat-min-t-1e26-bound.label: shortest run length at which a 1e26 FLOP run on one site draws less than the satellite reliable line, base year, the bound (lowest power per H100e, FP8, full utilisation): any longer run the adversary picks is below it

e8-smuggled-over-floor-1e26-now-p05.label: compute smuggled into one country over the chip floor of a 1e26 FLOP run at today's run length, 5th percentile

e8-smuggled-over-floor-1e26-pause-p50.label: compute smuggled into one country over the chip floor of a 1e26 FLOP run at a pause's run length, median of the Monte Carlo (floor at the BF16 reference precision; an FP8 run doubles the ratio)

e8-smuggled-run-now-p05.label: training compute the smuggled stock could do within today's longest sensible run, 5th percentile (smuggled stock and utilisation drawn)

e8-smuggled-run-pause-p05.label: training compute the smuggled stock could do within a pause's longest sensible run, 5th percentile (smuggled stock and utilisation drawn)

e8-thermal-margin-1e26-now.label: thermal infrared's margin over a 1e26 FLOP run on one site at today's run length, central inputs, a lower bound (the cluster it did not see drew at least 126 MW)

e8-years-to-cap-slow.label: years until the chip floor of the capability 1e26 FLOP buys, at a pause's run length, falls to MIRI's unmonitored cluster cap, at Gundlach et al.'s slow algorithmic rate
